description: Pinned source records for Elementary's upstream metapackage generation inputs. These inputs are separate from the 59 candidate image-package repositories.

generator_contract.reference_generator: Germinate 2.49 (Ubuntu source archive pinned by SHA-256 in reference_projects)
generator_contract.behavior_status: An independently authored Rust candidate composes supplied seed collections, resolves basic runtime package closure with per-seed scope, generates multi-architecture maps/lists from update.cfg and supplied bootstrap sets, renders substvars, and assembles metadata-only Debian packages. Linux synthetic comparisons qualify those stages; unchanged pinned Elementary source rules additionally qualify 32 checked-in map/list-to-package cases. Fresh real-source/archive list generation, PPA membership, complete solver/build-dependency behavior, live acquisition/bootstrap, changelog maintenance and full project/image/runtime parity remain open.
generator_contract.license_gate: Do not vendor upstream seed files into the local Rust project; load the separately pinned input at build time and review licensing before redistributing source or generated seed data.

license.evidence: The pinned repository tree has no LICENSE, COPYING, or COPYRIGHT file, and GitHub repository metadata declares no license.

parity_receipts.scope: Synthetic runtime package-set membership and fresh Debian substvars; excludes reason/diagnostic parity, complete provider/solver semantics, build dependencies, full Debian package output, and runtime/image qualification.

Synthetic runtime package membership, fresh substvars, and byte-for-byte metapackage map/list files. The unmodified updater consumes local archive/seed fixtures while debootstrap package-set/version output is fixed. Live debootstrap/acquisition, changelog changes, complete solver/reason/diagnostic semantics, Debian package output and image/runtime qualification are excluded.

Synthetic package binary-control field equality against dpkg-gencontrol at the dh_gencontrol staging boundary; installed documentation equality after decompression against Debhelper; dpkg-deb acceptance/extraction, payload md5sums, archive ownership/mode/timestamps and byte-reproducible native rebuilds. Both hosts, native/non-native/epoch versions, full/trimmed changelogs, architecture wildcards/all, relationship reduction, descriptions and long ustar paths are covered. No byte-equality claim against Debian compression, pinned real-source/PPA membership, arbitrary packaging, full solver, live bootstrap, image or runtime parity.

parity_receipts.scope: Checked-in upstream map/list-to-package stage.
